question.text: A For Profit Enterprise whose designated securities are listed on SSE shall comply with disclosure requirements under SEBI LODR Regulations with respect to issuers whose specified securities are listed on which of the following?

answer.text: The Main Board OR the SME Exchange OR the Innovators Growth Platform, as the case may be

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 3.2 states: 'A For Profit Enterprise whose designated securities are listed on the Stock Exchange(s) shall comply with the disclosure requirements contained in these regulations with respect to issuers whose specified securities are listed on the MAIN BOARD or the SME EXCHANGE or the INNOVATORS GROWTH PLATFORM, as the case may be.' The FPE's LODR obligations mirror its underlying listing board. The Trap: Options A, C, D each pick one board only. The correct answer is 'whichever applies' — the LODR compliance regime follows the board the FPE is actually listed on, not a one-size-fits-all. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/III-C (Compliance) is the primary cross-reference — LODR Main Board vs SME vs IGP disclosure timelines differ (quarterly vs half-yearly, etc.). SIAs must map the specific LODR chapter applicable to the FPE. Assessor's Pro-Tip: In SIA engagement planning for an FPE, first identify the equity/debt listing board, then pull the LODR schedule applicable, then layer the SSE-specific Chapter IX-A (NPO) or IX-B (FPE) on top. Mis-identifying the base regime is a common scope error.
